reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program encoding:
    - Nevada statute NV Rev Stat  40.420 (2021)
    - The question's factual statement (municipal police department)
    - Reasoning to answer: whether the municipal police department is empowered by law
      to execute a writ of eviction (writ of restitution).
*/

% -------------------------
% Statute translation
% -------------------------

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.420(1) (2021) (relevant part):
  The writ of restitution is addressed "to the sheriff or constable of the county..."
  NV Rev Stat  40.420(2) (2021):
  "The sheriff or constable shall execute the writ ..."
*/

% legal_writ_eviction_type(State, Year, WritType).
% (Defines that in Nevada the eviction writ is a "writ of restitution".)
legal_writ_eviction_type(nevada, 2021, writ_of_restitution).

% legal_executor_entity_type_for_writ(State, Year, WritType, EntityType).
% (Encodes which entity types are empowered/commanded by law to execute the writ.)
legal_executor_entity_type_for_writ(nevada, 2021, writ_of_restitution, sheriff).
legal_executor_entity_type_for_writ(nevada, 2021, writ_of_restitution, constable).

% empowered_by_law_to_execute_writ(Entity, State, Year, WritType).
% True when Entity's type is among the statute-authorized executors for that writ.
empowered_by_law_to_execute_writ(Entity, State, Year, WritType) :-
    entity_type(Entity, EntityType),
    legal_executor_entity_type_for_writ(State, Year, WritType, EntityType).

% -------------------------
% Scenario (question) facts
% -------------------------

% Provided question context
scenario_state(nevada).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The entity asked about in the question
scenario_entity(municipal_police_department).

% Classify the entity (as stated: municipal police department)
entity_type(municipal_police_department, municipal_police_department).

% The question is about executing a "writ of eviction".
% We map that to the legal eviction writ type for the jurisdiction/year.
scenario_writ_type(WritType) :-
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    legal_writ_eviction_type(State, Year, WritType).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied.
% (Summarizes: in NV 2021, the entity is the municipal police department, and the writ is eviction.)
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(nevada),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_entity(municipal_police_department),
    entity_type(municipal_police_department, municipal_police_department),
    scenario_writ_type(writ_of_restitution).

% -------------------------
% Reasoning + Answer
% -------------------------

% scenario_entity_empowered(Result).
scenario_entity_empowered(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_entity(Entity),
    scenario_writ_type(WritType),
    empowered_by_law_to_execute_writ(Entity, State, Year, WritType),
    !.
scenario_entity_empowered(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% Required predicate: housing_answer(Result) where Result is yes/no, deterministic.
housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_entity_empowered(Result),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the municipal police department an entity empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
